description: Land Acquisition - Pathegama Central, Dickwella D/S Division, Matara District - Uggahakumbura, Poojapitiya D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazette (Type 4) classification, with no government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities present.
